algorithm_policy.common_predicate_timing: Only after proof-complete native coverage of the entire closed hold and successful native proof replay.
algorithm_policy.predicate_unknown_rollback: Not applicable: common predicates do not control IVP steps. Preserve the completed native proof and report common UNKNOWN.
algorithm_policy.reject_and_retry: On native Picard/inclusion failure only, keep the same left endpoint and halve the attempted step exactly; retry the left portion. After acceptance, propagate the complete endpoint and start the next attempt with the remaining horizon.

external_guard_enforcement: Windows Job Object worker+replay bounds pinned by W2 G4 runner; child count one, job memory 1GiB, wall and CPU 60s, output caps frozen in protocol
input_binding: one explicit external comparison ID bijected to one peer G2 action and canonical physical-input digest; exact legacy native payload separately hashed

matched_worker.input_binding: three-case G4 native input manifest; physical digest and native case file hash both checked
matched_worker.invocation_scope: one explicit frozen comparison ID per process; no batch enumeration

mathematical_method: Frozen R4 exact-rational/Taylor residual/Picard method; no formula, Jacobian, inclusion, or proof-premise change.

memory_enforcement.mechanism: Windows Job Object; suspended process assignment before resume; kill-on-job-close
memory_enforcement.scope: one method worker containing native producer, independent native replay, and common replay; one 60s/1GiB envelope
memory_enforcement.timeout_mechanism: parent monotonic deadline; terminate complete Job Object

rational_precision: exact reduced rationals capped at 32768 bits for every numerator, denominator, and checked intermediate

residual_solver_profile.acceptance: accept only when every recomputed residual-derivative interval is a subset of its predecessor and the derived full-time remainder is a subset of its rough predecessor
residual_solver_profile.common_predicate_timing: after proof-complete full-hold coverage and native replay
residual_solver_profile.method: linear approximate path with exact rational slope; Auer residual derivative iteration and mean-value interval Jacobian
residual_solver_profile.rejection: bisect only after native Picard/inclusion failure; retry from the same left endpoint

retry_semantics: No cap, precision, tolerance, model, input, label or action changes. Only exact time bisection after failed native inclusion under the frozen limit is allowed.
rhs_jacobian_evaluation_scope: combined producer and native replay; report each method-native stage separately
scope: one canonical v6 W2 task input per frozen action; local Auer/Picard reconstruction, not VALENCIA binary
stopping_semantics: A true process-memory, wall, rational, work, proof-size or accepted/rejected-step cap is RESOURCE_LIMIT. Exhausted native inclusion halvings are INCLUSION_NOT_ESTABLISHED. Common UNKNOWN preserves a completed native proof.

transcendental_profile.range_reduction: none; exact rational Taylor polynomial plus global Lagrange remainder; broad range means UNKNOWN
